output.analysis: Tomas Reyes (South Fork Welding & Fabrication) is submitting an RFQ for various carbon steel pipe and socket weld fittings for the Tank Farm Phase 2 job. The RFQ is fully contained in the attached Word document ('TankFarm_Ph2_Materials.docx'), which organizes the material by type with clear default specifications specified by table headings. For the pipe section, the default 'Carbon Steel Pipe – SCH 80 SMLS A106B' applies to all rows unless a row overrides (none do). Ends are specified per line (PE = plain end, BE = beveled end). For fittings, all are 'Socket Weld Fittings – 3000# A105' as per the section heading. The list includes only material descriptions: no prices, totals, or hidden/struck content. The body and attachment both make clear this is a request for quote on all listed items. No lines are excluded; delivery instructions are not item requests.
